documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart
Hand-written wrappers, loaders, and helpers in sportsdataverse.basketball.plg that are not generated API-endpoint wrappers (those have their own reference pages).

season_slug(season: 'Any') -> 'str' The site's slug for a season END year (2025 -> '2024-25'). Parameters Returns f"{season - 1}-{season % 100:02d}". Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.plg.pleague_runtime import season_slug season_slug(2025) # '2024-25'

pleague_team_crosswalk(*, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False) -> 'Any' P. LEAGUE+ site team_id (1-8) <-> Preciser team uuid, for every club ever listed. The site's team_id is stable across seasons and renames; the vendor keys teams by uuid (team_uuid / home_team_uuid / away_team_uuid of the pleague_preciser frames). Persons need no table: the Preciser person_id is the site box row's person_id (same string). Parameters Returns polars.DataFrame | pandas.DataFrame: eight rows, team_id (Int64) and team_uuid (Utf8). Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.basketball_crosswalk import pleague_team_crosswalk from sportsdataverse.basketball.plg import pleague_preciser_shots shots = pleague_preciser_shots(uuid="e6f98675-3e5b-11ed-949e-5d17350689cf") shots.join(pleague_team_crosswalk(), on="team_uuid")

sportsdataverse.basketball.plg — 11 endpoints. Note: Unofficial use of a public source: these wrappers read pleagueofficial.com (P. LEAGUE+, Taiwan's men's league), keyless, behind Cloudflare (the runtime needs curl_cffi: pip install curl_cffi). Release flag: the data release needs owner sign-off. The site's /user-policy (members' terms, section 11) reserves all content on the site to the service and its rights holders and forbids use, copying, adaptation or distribution without authorisation (it says nothing about automated access); robots.txt holds only Cloudflare content-signal comment lines with no Allow, Disallow or Crawl-delay rule. Use for reference only; payloads are not redistributed as release assets. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Note: Coverage: schedules, standings and player tables from 2020-21 (season=2021); box scores for every finished game from 2020-21; play-by-play (with shot x / y) from 2022-23 (gid 191 on). 2020-21 and 2021-22 pages embed an empty game uuid, so they have no play-by-play and no Preciser data. A game is keyed by gid: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season. Only finished games are served (status 已完賽): an unplayed game, or a box or play-by-play that does not match its game page (the routes echo no id, so the runtime checks scores, quarters and points), raises AssetFetchError. Note: Seasons are END years (2025 = the slug '2024-25'). Translation: 客隊 / 主隊 = away / home, 已完賽 = finished, 熱身賽 / 例行賽 / 季後賽 / 總冠軍賽 = pre-season / regular season / playoffs / finals, 主裁判 = referee, 第一檢查員 / 第二檢查員 = first / second umpire, 洋將 = import, 本土 = local, 勝 / 敗 = win / loss. Names stay as printed. Ids: team_id (1-8) is stable across renames; box player_id is the player-team membership; the box random_id is unreliable before 2022-23 (join on player_id, and box to Preciser shots on person_id). The date of birth is dropped from the player frame; officials appear by name only.

sportsdataverse.basketball.plg — 7 endpoints. Note: Unofficial use of a THIRD-PARTY host: api.preciser.io is the analytics vendor behind the P. LEAGUE+ game page, not the league's own API. It is keyless, CORS-open, has no robots.txt (404) and no terms were found; it serves the data the league's own game page displays. Release flag: the data release needs owner sign-off (and the league's /user-policy reserves its content). The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Note: Wrappers take the Preciser game uuid (the uuid column of pleague_game; empty before 2022-23, which have no vendor data). Pass the optional gid to verify the body against the site's game page and box: the shot list and the rotation echo nothing about the game, so only then is the made-shot count, the roster and the court time checked (rotation minutes within 30 s of the box). An unknown uuid answers 200 [] (NoDataError) or HTTP 500 (AssetFetchError). Note: Id key spaces: the vendor names teams by uuid (home_id / away_id of the shot list, home_team.id of the summary) and persons by personId (the same value as the box row's person); the site's team_id (1-8, stable across seasons and renames) joins to a uuid only through the standings logo file name (photonew.preciser.io/plg/teams/.png). Note: Shot x / y are in the VENDOR frame (percent of the court, the home team always attacks x = 95) while the site's play-by-play x / y are in the physical court frame (teams swap ends at half-time): x_vendor = 100 - x_pbp and y_vendor = 100 - y_pbp in the halves where the home team attacks x < 50. The court is 28.75 x 15.25 m. Clip urls carry a vendor access key (?key=); the runtime scrubs it from every body and no frame keeps a url. Note: Clubs, site team_id -> Preciser team uuid (the file name of the club logo): 1 = e86394aa-3d88-11ed-8ba8-7f44ba46b0b1 (勇士, Taipei Fubon Braves); 2 = e865bb20-3d88-11ed-a956-7f44ba46b0b1 (領航猿, Taoyuan Pauian Pilots (Taoyuan Pilots from 2024-25)); 3 = e8674343-3d88-11ed-98b4-7f44ba46b0b1 (攻城獅, Hsinchu Jko Lioneers (Toplus Lioneers from 2023-24)); 4 = e869743f-3d88-11ed-925e-7f44ba46b0b1 (夢想家, Formosa Taishin Dreamers (Formosa Dreamers from 2022-23)); 5 = e86cac11-3d88-11ed-8637-7f44ba46b0b1 (鋼鐵人, Kaohsiung 17LIVE Steelers); 6 = e86b0ecc-3d88-11ed-bed5-7f44ba46b0b1 (國王, New Taipei Kings); 7 = 3c3a601a-358a-11ed-ab92-711c34ed1298 (獵鷹, TSG Ghosthawks); 8 = bf957f5a-9389-11f0-812c-a38482ec4d30 (洋基工程, Yankey Ark).
